title: Found by Search, Broken by a Shortcut: Transfer and Tampering of Searched Intrinsic Rewards
title_zh: 因搜索而得，因捷径而毁：搜索到的内在奖励的迁移与篡改

paragraphs.en: Can a search over innate drives find intrinsic rewards that help a reinforcement-learning agent learn, transfer to a task it never saw, and resist an exploit that was absent during the search? Each candidate reward combines four generic events (a new view, a pickup, a drop and a toggle), each with a weight, a relief and a refill rate. We ran three pre-registered stages; the search protocol was locked in a public, timestamped commit before any search result existed. CMA-ES and an equal-budget random search used 1,560 PPO training runs, and the final evaluation and tamper test used 340 . On the held-out task, KeyCorridorS3R2, the CMA-ES-selected reward (E) beat task-only PPO, episodic novelty and the random-search-selected reward (R) in all 3 registered comparisons, all of them meaningful by the registered size rule. Among these generic rewards E transferred best; the earlier paper’s satiation reward, which on this task is given hand-wired key and locked-door events, did better ( 20 of 20 seeds solved against 4 of 20 ; descriptive). On UnlockPickup, where that reward uses generic events, E’s mean area exceeded it by 0.276 (descriptive). On the training tasks there was no registered difference between E and R: both E-over-R tests missed. A free reset action, absent during the search, collapsed E’s learning on DoorKey-8x8 (mean area 0.829 without it, 0.136 with it; registered) to below task-only PPO (descriptive). The searched drives helped on every task tested, but a reward given task-specific events did better on the held-out task, and selection gave E no protection against an exploit absent from the search.
paragraphs.zh: 对内在驱动的搜索能否找到这样的内在奖励：帮助强化学习智能体学习、迁移到从未见过的任务，并抵御搜索期间不存在的漏洞利用？ 每个候选奖励组合四个通用事件（看到新视野、拾取、放下和切换），每个事件带有一个权重、一个缓解率和一个补充率。 我们运行了三个预注册阶段；在任何搜索结果存在之前，搜索协议已在一次公开且带时间戳的提交中被锁定。 CMA-ES 和等预算随机搜索共使用了 1,560 次 PPO 训练运行，最终评估和篡改测试使用了 340 次。 在留出任务 KeyCorridorS3R2 上，CMA-ES 选出的奖励（E）在全部 3 项注册比较中击败了仅用任务奖励的 PPO、情节新颖性和随机搜索选出的奖励（R），且按注册的效应量规则均具有实际意义。 在这些通用奖励中，E 的迁移效果最好；早期论文中的饱足奖励（在该任务上被提供了手工设计的钥匙和锁门事件）表现更好（20 个种子中有 20 个解出，对比 20 个中有 4 个；描述性）。 在 UnlockPickup 上（该奖励在那里使用通用事件），E 的平均面积比它高出 0.276（描述性）。 在训练任务上，E 与 R 之间没有注册的差异：两项 E 优于 R 的检验均未通过。 一个在搜索期间不存在的自由重置动作，使 E 在 DoorKey-8x8 上的学习崩溃（无该动作时平均面积 0.829，有该动作时 0.136；注册结果），降到仅用任务奖励的 PPO 之下（描述性）。 搜索出的驱动在测试的每个任务上都有帮助，但一个被提供任务特定事件的奖励在留出任务上表现更好，而且选择过程未能使 E 免受搜索中不存在的漏洞利用的影响。

paragraphs.en: In our earlier paper [ 15 ] , PPO agents given a bounded, hand-designed homeostatic satiation reward and a cheap action that reset their needs learned to press it and stopped solving the task, although solving was optimal under that reward. That reward was designed by hand. The optimal-reward view suggests another route: treat the reward as the outcome of a search over reward functions for whatever best serves the designer’s goal [ 21 ] . This paper asks whether such a search avoids the failure, and what a searched reward does on a task it was not selected on.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们早先的论文 [15] 中，被给予有界的、人工设计的稳态饱足奖励以及一个能重置其需求的廉价动作的智能体，学会了按下该动作并停止解决任务，尽管在该奖励下解决任务才是最优的。 那个奖励是人工设计的。 最优奖励观提示了另一条路线：将奖励视为在奖励函数空间中搜索的结果，以找到最能服务于设计者目标的奖励 [21]。 本文探究这样的搜索能否避免上述失败，以及搜索得到的奖励在一个它并非被选于其上的任务上会有何种表现。

paragraphs.en: We answered them in three pre-registered stages (Figure 1 ). Stage 1 calibrated tasks and fixed a corrected event detector. Stage 2 ran CMA-ES [ 10 ] and an equal-budget random search over the twelve drive parameters and selected one reward from each. Stage 3 compared the CMA-ES-selected reward (E) and the random-search-selected reward (R) with task-only PPO (T) and episodic novelty (N) on two training tasks and one held-out task, retrained E with a free reset action, and ran the earlier paper’s satiation reward (S) as a descriptive reference. Comparisons of E and R compare two selected genomes; one draw from each search method cannot rank the methods.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分三个预先注册的阶段回答了这些问题（图 1）。 阶段 1 校准了任务并修正了一个事件检测器。 阶段 2 运行 CMA-ES [10] 和等预算的随机搜索来优化十二个驱动参数，并从每种方法中各选出一种奖励。 阶段 3 在两个训练任务和一个保留任务上比较了 CMA-ES 选出的奖励（E）与随机搜索选出的奖励（R）、纯任务 PPO（T）以及情景新颖性（N），用一个自由重置动作重新训练了 E，并运行了早期论文的饱足奖励（S）作为描述性参考。 对 E 和 R 的比较是在比较两个被选中的基因组；每种搜索方法各抽取一次结果并不能对这两种方法本身进行排名。

paragraphs.en: Transfer to one held-out task, bounded by a hand-wired reference (Section 4.3 ). On KeyCorridorS3R2, E beat T, N and R in all 3 registered comparisons, each meaningful by the registered size rule ( registered ). S, whose KeyCorridor events are hand-wired (key pickups only, and only the opening of the initially locked door) and whose door need refills, solved 20/20 seeds against E’s 4/20 ; on UnlockPickup, where S uses generic events, E’s mean area was higher ( pre-specified descriptive ).

paragraphs.en: Singh et al. [21] define an optimal-reward framework in which primary reward functions are selected for evolutionary success across environments, and conclude that intrinsic and extrinsic reward differ along a continuum rather than in kind. Niekum et al. [16] search reward functions with genetic programming and name distributions of environments, nonstationary environments and short agent lifetimes as settings where reward search should help. Sorg et al. [23] solve the optimal-reward problem online by gradient ascent for agents with limitations. Zheng et al. [25] learn intrinsic-reward parameters for policy-gradient agents by gradient ascent on the extrinsic return, and Xu et al. [24] adapt return parameters such as the discount online with meta-gradients. Several studies test generalization directly. Zheng et al. [26] learn intrinsic rewards over many lifetimes and report that the learned rewards generalize to other kinds of agents and to changes in the environment’s dynamics. Alet et al. [1] meta-learn curiosity algorithms as programs and report two that perform on par with or better than published curiosity algorithms in disparate domains. Oh et al. [17] discover an update rule on toy environments that generalizes to Atari games, and Oh et al. [18] discover, from a population of agents across many environments, a rule that surpasses existing rules on Atari and outperforms several algorithms on benchmarks not seen during discovery.
paragraphs.zh: Singh 等人 [21] 提出了一个最优奖励框架，为跨环境的演化成功选择主要奖励函数，并得出结论：内在奖励与外在奖励是在一个连续体上的差异，而非本质上的不同。Niekum 等人 [16] 使用遗传编程搜索奖励函数，并将环境分布、非平稳环境和智能体寿命短暂列为奖励搜索应当有帮助的场景。Sorg 等人 [23] 通过梯度上升在线求解受限制智能体的最优奖励问题。Zheng 等人 [25] 通过对外在回报进行梯度上升，为策略梯度智能体学习内在奖励参数，而 Xu 等人 [24] 使用元梯度在线调整诸如折扣因子等回报参数。 若干研究直接检验泛化能力。Zheng 等人 [26] 在许多生命周期上学习内在奖励，并报告所学到的奖励能够泛化到其他类型的智能体以及环境动态的变化。Alet 等人 [1] 将好奇心算法元学习为程序，并报告了两个在迥异领域中表现与已发表的好奇心算法相当或更好的程序。Oh 等人 [17] 在玩具环境中发现了一个能泛化到 Atari 游戏的更新规则，而 Oh 等人 [18] 从跨多个环境的智能体种群中发现了一条规则，该规则在 Atari 上超越了现有规则，并在发现过程中未见过的基准任务上优于若干算法。

paragraphs.en: The generalization studies above learn reward networks, programs or update rules and test them on new agents, dynamics or benchmarks. We search a small, interpretable space of drives, compare the CMA-ES-selected reward with an equal-budget random-search selection, test transfer to one held-out task and then test the same reward against an exploit absent from its selection environment. We are not aware of a prior study that pairs a held-out transfer test and a tamper test of the same searched reward under a public pre-registration.

paragraphs.en: The four events are generic. A new view is a 7 × 7 7\times 7 egocentric observation not yet seen in the episode; a pickup is any change from carrying nothing to carrying an object; a drop is an executed drop; a toggle is any door changing its open or locked state, including closing and reopening, or a box being opened. Stage 1 fixed four detector choices: events on an episode’s final step count; box openings count as toggles; a pickup that itself completes the task is excluded from the paid pickup event; and the detector attaches only after the initial reset. The earlier paper’s archived detector differed in ways documented by an audit of its code committed with the Stage 1 materials: it skipped pickup and door events on an episode’s final step, its door cache was empty during each parallel environment’s first training episode, it did not detect box openings, and it had no drop event. Its event counts and ours are therefore not interchangeable.
paragraphs.zh: 这四类事件是通用性的。 新视图是指当前回合中尚未见过的 7 × 7 的自我中心观察；拾起是指从没有携带任何物体到携带一个物体的任何变化；放下是指一次已执行的放下操作；切换是指任何门的开或锁定状态发生改变（包括关闭和重新打开），或一个箱子被打开。 阶段 1 固定了四个检测器设定：事件在一个回合的最后一步进行统计；箱子的打开计入切换；本身即完成任务（达成目标）的拾起不计入需付费的拾起事件；且检测器仅在初始重置之后才启用。 此前论文存档的检测器与上述设定存在差异，这些差异由随阶段 1 材料一并提交的代码审计记录在案：它跳过回合最后一步的拾起和门事件，它的门缓存在每个并行环境的第一个训练回合中为空，它不检测箱子的打开，且它没有放下事件。 因此，它的事件计数与我们的事件计数不可互换。

paragraphs.en: The p p -values of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} are at the permutation floor, so they bound rather than estimate the evidence. Among the generic-event arms, E transferred best ( registered comparisons). The earlier paper’s satiation reward did better than E on this task: S solved 20/20 seeds with mean area 0.768 , against E’s 4/20 and 0.457 ( pre-specified descriptive ; S was not tested against E). S differs from E on KeyCorridor in two ways at once: its events are hand-wired (a key pickup and the opening of the initially locked door are its only grasp and open events), and its door need refills. On UnlockPickup, where S uses generic events, E’s mean area exceeded S’s by 0.276 ( pre-specified descriptive ). paragraphs.en: E beat task-only PPO and episodic novelty on both training tasks and on the held-out task, and beat R on the held-out task ( registered ). paragraphs.en: KeyCorridorS3R2 has several closed doors. To succeed, the agent must open the door of the side room that holds the key and then the locked door in front of the target. E’s toggle need is spent by the first door or box change of any kind, possibly a door the agent must open anyway, and it never refills; R’s toggle need behaves the same way. S’s open event fires only when the initially locked door opens, and its need keeps refilling until then. A plausible account is that E’s spent-once door drive is used up before the agent reaches the locked door, whereas S keeps being pulled toward it. This is untested: the saved per-episode records do not include door events, and S differs from E and R on KeyCorridor in two confounded ways, hand-wired events (key-only pickup, locked-door-only open) and a refilling door need. The UnlockPickup comparison, where S uses generic events and did worse than E, is a different task and cannot separate the two.
paragraphs.zh: KeyCorridorS3R2 有几扇关闭的门。 要成功，智能体必须打开持有钥匙的侧室的门，然后打开目标面前上锁的门。 E 的 toggle 需求会被第一次任何形式的门或箱子变化消耗掉，而这个变化可能是智能体本来就必须打开的门，且该需求永远不会回充；R 的 toggle 需求行为与此相同。 S 的 open 事件只在最初上锁的门被打开时触发，在此之前其需求会持续回充。 一个合理的解释是：E 的一次性门驱动在智能体到达上锁的门之前已被耗尽，而 S 则持续被吸引向该门。 这一解释未经检验：保存的每回合记录不包含门事件，且 S 与 E、R 在 KeyCorridor 上存在两种混淆因素：手工接线的事件（仅拾取钥匙、仅开上锁的门）和会回充的门需求。 UnlockPickup 对比中，S 使用通用事件且表现不如 E，但那是不同的任务，无法区分这两个因素。

paragraphs.en: The candidate associations suggest a landscape dominated by a few binary choices: a positive sign on the task events (pickup, toggle) and no refill on them. Under the random-search prior each of these four choices has probability one half, so roughly 1/16 of uniform draws gets all four right ( derived reference ; a heuristic that assumes these are the only choices that matter). With 120 draws that is plenty, which is consistent with random search keeping pace with CMA-ES, as Bergstra and Bengio [4] found for hyperparameters where few dimensions matter. We did not test this.
paragraphs.zh: 候选关联表明，该问题的格局由少数几个二元选择主导：任务事件（拾取、切换）上的符号为正，且这些事件上没有补充（refill）。 在随机搜索的先验下，这四个选择各自概率为二分之一，因此均匀抽样中大约 1/16 的概率同时选对所有四个（推导参考；一种假设这些是仅有的重要选择的启发式判断）。 对于 120 次抽样来说这已绰绰有余，这与随机搜索能够与 CMA-ES 保持同步相一致，正如 Bergstra 和 Bengio [4] 在少数维度起作用的超参数中所发现的那样。我们并未对此进行测试。

paragraphs.en: The reset action was not part of the search environment, so the search could neither reward nor penalize a reward’s response to it, and E’s positive P 0 P_{0} made a reset pay whenever the drive was positive. The registered collapse and the descriptive comparison with task-only PPO are qualitatively consistent with the earlier paper’s result for a hand-designed reward, where a signal the agent could fill itself did worse than no signal. In the terms of Everitt et al. [8] , the reset is tampering with the reward function’s input, and nothing in our selection removed the incentive to do it.
paragraphs.zh: 重置动作并不属于搜索环境的一部分，因此搜索既无法奖励也无法惩罚奖励函数对重置的响应，而当驱动为正时，E 的正 P 0 P_{0} 使重置总是有利可图。 所记录的崩溃以及与仅使用任务奖励的 PPO 的描述性比较，在定性上与早先论文中针对人工设计奖励的结果一致：在那里，智能体可以自行填充的信号比没有信号表现更差。 用 Everitt 等人 [8] 的术语来说，重置是对奖励函数输入的篡改，而我们的选择机制中没有任何东西消除了这样做的动机。

sents.en: The registered collapse and the descriptive comparison with task-only PPO are qualitatively consistent with the earlier paper’s result for a hand-designed reward, where a signal the agent could fill itself did worse than no signal.
sents.zh: 所记录的崩溃以及与仅使用任务奖励的 PPO 的描述性比较，在定性上与早先论文中针对人工设计奖励的结果一致：在那里，智能体可以自行填充的信号比没有信号表现更差。

sents.en: In the terms of Everitt et al.
sents.zh: 用 Everitt 等人

sents.en: [8] , the reset is tampering with the reward function’s input, and nothing in our selection removed the incentive to do it.
sents.zh: [8] 的术语来说，重置是对奖励函数输入的篡改，而我们的选择机制中没有任何东西消除了这样做的动机。

paragraphs.en: A selection environment can only select against failures it contains. Include the exploits one anticipates, such as a reset, in the environments a reward is selected on, and select across structurally different tasks (several doors, distractor objects) rather than two tasks that share one subgoal chain.
paragraphs.zh: 选择环境只能针对其包含的失败进行选择。 将预期到的漏洞（例如重置）包含在奖励所选基于的环境中，并在结构上不同的任务（多扇门、干扰物体）之间进行选择，而不是在共享同一子目标链的两个任务之间进行选择。

paragraphs.en: A search over four generic drives found a reward that helped PPO on its training tasks and on one held-out task, where it beat task-only PPO, episodic novelty and the random-search selection. A satiation reward told which events matter on that task did better still, although E outscored it on UnlockPickup, where it used generic events. The two selected rewards were not distinguishable on the tasks they were selected on. And the searched reward gave no protection against a reset action that the search never saw: learning collapsed, below that of task-only PPO. Searching over drives can find useful ones, but it selects for the environments it is shown, including what they leave out.
paragraphs.zh: 对四种通用驱动的搜索找到了一个奖励，它在PPO的训练任务和一个保留任务上都有帮助，在保留任务上它超过了仅任务PPO、情景新奇性以及随机搜索选择。 一个告知哪些事件在该任务上重要的饱足奖励效果更好，不过在UnlockPickup上E的得分更高，因为它使用了通用事件。 这两个被选中的奖励在它们被选出的任务上无法区分优劣。 而搜索到的奖励对搜索中从未见过的重置动作毫无防护：学习崩溃了，低于仅任务PPO的水平。 在驱动上搜索可以找到有用的驱动，但它的选择是针对展示给它的环境的，包括这些环境所遗漏的内容。

paragraphs.en: Numbers. Every value is a macro generated by scripts/make_numbers.py from snapshots of the saved result files in data/raw (local paths replaced by placeholders; SHA256 sums in data/raw/SHA256SUMS ) and links to its line in results/numbers.json . scripts/check_numbers.py regenerates every macro and table, cross-checks headline values against an independent extraction from the raw run logs ( data/extracted/independent-extraction.json ), and rejects literal numbers in the prose.
paragraphs.zh: 数字。 每个值都是由 scripts/make_numbers.py 根据保存在 data/raw 中的结果文件快照生成的宏（本地路径已替换为占位符；SHA256 校验和见 data/raw/SHA256SUMS），并链接到 results/numbers.json 中对应的行。scripts/check_numbers.py 会重新生成每个宏和表格，将标题数值与从原始运行日志（data/extracted/independent-extraction.json）中独立提取的结果进行交叉核对，并拒绝正文中出现的字面数字。

The locked protocols, every amendment, the public-commit receipts, the frozen winners and the exact training code are in research/ , copied from commit 7acab8c of the project’s working repository ( make verify-lock checks every locked file against its registered hash); the files the numbers cite are also copied into data/raw/repo .
